messages:
Priya Nair (Sales): Heads up — Cumulus Health asked for a 90-day technical trial with credits. They want deep pricing while they port data. Can we fast-track an approval? Link: https://gd.doc/cumulus-trial
Sam Cole (Finance): Need specifics: expected monthly token usage, ARR signal, and whether they want post-pay or prepaid. Deep discount needs Deal Desk approval.
Priya Nair (Sales): They estimated ~2M tokens/mo during pilot. They're willing to prepay $30k, but want us to apply $60k credit (effectively ~66% off) so pilot is free net-net.
Diego Park (RevOps): Typical guardrails: 1) Cap credits to a fixed dollar amount, 2) Require a signed SOW/MSA addendum, 3) Billing line item tagged "Pilot Credit - OneTime", 4) Usage cap in tokens. Propose: cap credit at $30k (matching prepay), max 4M tokens, 50% off equivalent.
Ava Li (Legal): We can do addendum. Need explicit audit rights, data processing terms, and an expiration clause for credits. Draft clause suggestion: "PilotCredit: Customer will receive a one-time billing credit not to exceed $30,000 applied to invoices generated during the Pilot Term. Credits are non-transferable, expire 30 days after Pilot Term, and are conditioned on Customer complying with usage reporting and audit requests."
Sam Cole (Finance): Finance position: Approve up to $30k credit (not $60k). Discount structure: one-time credit against invoices; no changes to base pricing after pilot unless commercial team obtains new approval. Also require prepayment or purchase order.
deal-bot: Discount override check: Requested credit exceeds standard SDR limit. Automated escalation required: finance + legal approval. Case ID: deal-2819990000.
Priya Nair (Sales): Customer says prepay is fine. I'll get PO and push addendum for signature today. They prefer billing in arrears but can do upfront cc.
Diego Park (RevOps): I'll prepare billing item: "Pilot Credit - Cumulus Health (Q2)" amount = $30,000, non-recurring, allocation = credit. Will set token cap enforcement rule to 4,000,000 tokens; any overage billed at list price.
Ava Li (Legal): Legal sign-off on addendum language with audit + DPT + expiry. Also recommend adding indemnity carveout for misuse during pilot.
Sam Cole (Finance): Official sign-off from Finance: Approve one-time credit up to $30k, subject to: signed addendum, PO/prepayment, token cap enforcement, weekly usage reports, and audit rights. Sam Cole (Finance) 2819990123
Priya Nair (Sales): Great — I have the PO in-hand and the customer agreed to the 4M token cap. I'll drop the signed addendum here when complete. :thumbsup:
